title: UI_Test: Automated End-to-End Test Suite
description: Automated verification suite generated from AST parsing of UI_Test. Covers 3 pages (dashboard.html, home.html, index.html) and 8 interactive elements.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the home page, when the user types into email and types into password and clicks togglePasswordBtn, the submission should process
Given the home page, when the user leaves the email field empty and clicks togglePasswordBtn, a validation error should be visible
Given the application page, when the user clicks 'Sign Out', the expected UI update should occur
Given the application page, when the user clicks 'Run System Diagnostics', the expected UI update should occur
Given the application page, when the user clicks 'Download Access Logs', the expected UI update should occur
Given the application page, when the user clicks the 'home.html' link, they should navigate to 'home.html'
